ban.title: This account is banned

memberships.title: Institutions
memberships.empty: Not a member of any institution. They use Waqaya as an individual trainee.

activity.title: Activity
activity.auditLink: Their actions in the audit log

sessions.title: Active sessions

sessions.revokeDescription: The device is signed out right away. The user can sign in again.

actions.title: Account actions
actions.description: Every action is recorded in the audit log under your name.
actions.promoteDescription: Platform admins can see and change everything: users, institutions, content and AI settings.
actions.demoteDescription: They keep their account and institutions but can no longer open the admin panel.
actions.editorPromoteDescription: They can create, edit and publish the global protocols and simulation scenarios, and read institutions' protocols. They cannot see users, institutions or the rest of the admin area.
actions.editorDemoteDescription: Their account and institution memberships stay, but they can no longer edit global protocols or scenarios.
actions.banDescription: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until the ban ends or you lift it.
actions.banReasonHint: Visible to platform admins only. It is not copied into the audit log.
actions.unbanDescription: They can sign in again right away.
actions.revokeAllDescription: Every session of this account ends. They can sign in again with their password.
actions.impersonateDescription: You will see Waqaya exactly as they do, for up to one hour. Starting and ending this are recorded in the audit log under your name, but not every change made inside their account is, so look rather than change.
actions.impersonateReturn: To come back, use “Return to my account” on the next page, or open the admin panel (/admin), which always leads back to that button. Signing out also ends it, but you then sign in again with your own account.
actions.impersonateAdmin: Other platform admins cannot be impersonated.
actions.impersonateBanned: Lift the ban before acting as this user.
actions.deleteDescription: Their profile, sessions, memberships and their own simulation attempts are deleted for good.
actions.deleteKeeps: Scans they examined and the audit trail stay with their institutions, without their name.
actions.deleteConfirm: To confirm, type this e-mail address:
actions.blockedTitle: This account cannot be deleted yet
actions.blockedOwner: It is the only owner of {organizations}, which still has other members. Make another member an owner first.
actions.blockedAdmin: It is the last active platform admin. Make someone else a platform admin first.
actions.blockedDescription: Fix this first, then you can delete {name}'s account:
actions.demoteDescriptionManaged: They keep their account but can no longer open the admin panel. Their access to institutions is separate from this role and stays unless you remove it below.
actions.demoteMemberships: They own or manage these institutions:
actions.demoteLeave: Also remove them from these institutions
actions.demoteKept: Platform admin was removed, but they are still a member of {organizations}. An institution's only owner stays until someone else owns it; you can remove them from its page.

impersonation.title: Acting as another user
impersonation.description: You are signed in as {name} through the admin panel.
impersonation.explain: Pages now show what this user sees. Starting and ending this are recorded in the audit log under your name, but not every change made inside their account is, so look rather than change. This session ends by itself within an hour.
impersonation.failed: Could not return to your account. Sign out, then sign in again.
impersonation.comeBack: To come back later, open {address} in this browser: it brings you back to this page.

organizations.description: Create institutions, manage their members and invitations, and suspend or delete them.

badges.invitations: {count, plural, one {{n} pending invitation} other {{n} pending invitations}}

empty.title: No institutions yet
empty.description: Create the first institution and invite its owner by email.

noResults.title: No matching institutions
noResults.description: Try another name, or clear the filters.

noneOfMine.title: You are not a member of any institution
noneOfMine.description: Institutions you create or join appear here. Leave each one once its own managers are in place.

createOrg.title: New institution
createOrg.description: Add a university, hospital, training center or government body, then invite its owner.
createOrg.nameEnHint: Shown when the site is in English.
createOrg.ownerHint: We email an invitation to join as the institution's owner. You can also invite later.
createOrg.creatorNote: You become an owner of the new institution too, so that you can send its invitations. Leave it from its page once its owner has joined.
createOrg.invited: Institution created and the owner invited
createOrg.inviteFailed: The institution was created, but the invitation was not sent: {reason}

suspendedAlert.title: This institution is suspended
suspendedAlert.description: Its members cannot use it and its managers cannot change it until you reactivate it. Its data is kept.

noOwnerAlert.title: This institution has no owner
noOwnerAlert.description: Make one of its members an owner, or join it and invite a new owner by email.

org.editDescription: Names in both languages and the type of institution.
org.suspendDescription: Members lose access to the institution and its data until you reactivate it. Nothing is deleted.
org.unsuspendDescription: Its members get their access back right away.
org.deleteDescription: The institution and everything it owns are deleted for good: members, invitations, departments, its own protocols and scenarios, scans and their photos.
org.deleteImpact: {members, plural, =0 {It has no members} one {{m} member loses access} other {{m} members lose access}}, and {scans, plural, =0 {no scans are deleted} one {{s} scan is deleted} other {{s} scans are deleted}}.
org.deleteKeeps: Attempts on the platform's own scenarios stay with each trainee. If the data must be kept, suspend the institution instead.
org.deleteConfirm: To confirm, type the institution's name (in Arabic or English):

membership.title: Your access
membership.member: You are a member of this institution ({role}).
membership.memberHint: Your new sessions may open in this institution. Leave it once its own managers are in place.
membership.leaveDescription: You stay a platform admin and can still manage it from here.
membership.leaveInvitations: Pending invitations you sent will stop working ({n}).
membership.notMember: You are not a member of this institution.
membership.notMemberHint: You can change roles and remove members without joining. To send invitations, join it as an owner.
membership.joinDescription: You appear in its member list as an owner and can send invitations. Leave again when you are done.
membership.leaveNowTitle: Its own owner is in place
membership.leaveNow: You no longer need owner access to it. Leave now, so that its scans, photos and members are open only to its own staff. You can still manage it from this panel.

members.title: Members
members.description: Roles inside this institution. An institution with members always keeps at least one owner.
members.empty: This institution has no members yet.
members.removeDescription: They lose access to it. Scans and results they recorded stay with the institution.
members.removeInvitations: Pending invitations they sent will stop working ({n}).
members.lowerDescription: They lose the rights of the “{from}” role in this institution at once.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Each invitation is emailed. You can also copy its link and send it yourself.
invitations.noLongerValid: No longer valid: the person who invited has left
invitations.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Copy it from the field instead.
invitations.cancelDescription: The link stops working. You can invite this address again later.
invitations.joinFirst: Join the institution as an owner to send invitations.
invitations.ownerExists: This institution already has an owner, or an owner invitation is pending. An owner controls all of its members and data: invite another one only if the institution asked for it.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Departments are managed by the institution's own managers.

reasons.requested: Requested by the institution or the person

ai.description: The model, effort and daily limit for every AI call, with usage, costs and failures.

settings.title: AI settings
settings.description: Changes apply to the next AI call, for everyone. Each change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.resetDescription: The value saved here is removed. The server's environment variable, or the built-in default, applies again.

model.title: Model
model.description: The Claude model that analyzes scans and writes simulation debriefs.
model.label: Model id
model.hint: For example claude-opus-5-5: lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens, starting with claude-.
model.noPrice: There is no price on file for this model, so its calls show no cost estimate.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How much the model thinks before it answers. More effort is slower and costs more.
effort.label: Effort level

hints.low: The fastest and cheapest answers. Best for simple checks.
hints.medium: A balance of quality, speed and cost. The recommended level.
hints.high: More careful answers for harder photos, a little slower.
hints.xhigh: Very careful answers. Noticeably slower and more expensive.
hints.max: The most thorough answers. The slowest and most expensive level.

limit.title: Daily limit per person
limit.description: How many AI calls one person can make per day (Riyadh time). It protects the platform from runaway costs.
limit.label: Calls per person per day
limit.hint: From 0 to 10,000. The built-in default is {n}.
limit.zeroWarning: 0 turns AI off for everyone: scans can then only be reviewed by hand, and simulations get no debrief.

totals.title: Usage
totals.description: AI calls and their estimated cost. Days and months follow Riyadh time.

failures.title: Failure log
failures.description: Failed, refused and stalled calls of the last {days} days, by cause.

states.stalledHint: The call never finished: the server stopped or restarted while it was running.

errorCodes.truncated: The answer was cut off before it was complete.
errorCodes.invalid_output: The answer did not have the expected format.
errorCodes.rate_limited: The AI provider's rate limit was reached (not billed).
errorCodes.overloaded: The AI provider was overloaded or had an error (not billed).
errorCodes.timeout: The call took too long and was stopped.
errorCodes.aborted: The person canceled or left the page.
errorCodes.bad_request: The provider rejected the request (not billed).
errorCodes.config: The API key was rejected: check the server's AI configuration (not billed).
errorCodes.not_configured: The AI service is not configured on the server.
errorCodes.daily_limit: The person had reached the daily limit.
errorCodes.too_many_requests: Too many calls from the same person at once.
